'''Dael''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] and [[Major/Legends|major]] of [[Base D-55]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. After the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] was completed, Dael was one of the commanders that refused to comply any conditions set forth from the Treaty and knew that the contract would not last long. During the [[Battle of Dantooine (Great Galactic War)|battle of Dantooine]], Dael was visited by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Harron Tavus]] to convince Dael to call in a retreat. Refusing to withdraw, Dael openly engaged against the Imperial forces along with other military commanders.
